chapter: Kline 1980: early years and founding of the Goldkette orchestra
title: Boyhood in Niagara Falls and Chambersburg; his pianist father
summary: Born in Niagara Falls in 1902, he grew up partly in Chambersburg, Pennsylvania; his father was a store clerk and post office worker who played piano professionally, including in a theater.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Chauncey would you, before we get into the jazz, would you tell me about your boyhood, where you were born and when you were born.
I was born in Niagara Falls.
Okay. Did you grow up in Niagara Falls?
And when did you go - you moved to Pennsylvania, Chambersburg, later?
Went to Pennsylvania, yeah. And my father was working in Pennsylvania.
Uh huh. Okay. And he worked in a post office.
He worked in a post office after he came back to Chambersburg.
I see. Okay. Was your father musical?
Tell me about it. Where did he play?
He played every place you could play.
He played in a theater too, didn't he?
Yeah, he played in a theater.
And did you play with him?
